title: HCP · Operations
description: Operational signals and explicit readiness gaps. Missing observations are unknown.

panels.description:
## Operations / HCP
Runtime availability, scheduler backlog and lease pressure. **Blocked / approval waits are informational** and include blocked tasks, not exclusively human approvals.

panels.title: HCP API
panels.description: API health probe: successful response is healthy. Live exporter and fresh collector required.

targets.expr: (smokemap_source_success{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins",source="hcp_api"}) and on(job,instance) (up{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins"} == 1) and on(job,instance) ((time() - smokemap_collector_timestamp_seconds{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins"}) >= 0) and on(job,instance) ((time() - smokemap_collector_timestamp_seconds{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins"}) <= 180) and on(job,instance) (node_textfile_scrape_error{job="smokemap-monitoring",host="jenkins"} == 0)

panels.title: Firing alerts · action context
panels.description: No rows means no matching firing alerts. Check monitoring health and the Prometheus signal before concluding all clear.

panels.title: Signal coverage
panels.description:
### Interpret the queue
Queue count and oldest age cover queued / pending tasks. Lease expiry uses a 120s grace. Failures count updates in the last hour.

Active workers, capacity and completed-task throughput are not collected. Empty alert rows are not proof of source freshness.
